
```{devoirs_choices dynamical_rule_13_two_choices}
- A rule specifying how the state changes over the next instant from each possible state.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A list of every state the system has occupied in the past.:
    correct: false
    feedback: That is historical data; the dynamical rule specifies change from a
      current state.
- A description of how quickly position changes with respect to position.:
    correct: false
    feedback: The dynamical rule gives the rate of state change with time as a function
      of state.
- A function giving the direction and rate at which the state moves through state space.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A time series showing the state at successive times.:
    correct: false
    feedback: A time series records state over time; the dynamical rule maps state
      to rate of change.
```
